words.sense: Strong enough to endure pressure or rough use without failing.
misconceptions: Assuming staying intact and recovering later are identical.

words.sense: Able to regain function, form, or strength after strain or a setback.
misconceptions: Assuming something that bends briefly must be weak.

semantic_axes.description: Robust describes holding up under a challenge; resilient describes bouncing back after the challenge has caused strain or a setback.
